admission_confirmed.outstanding_followup: Network fetch+verify of permissive foreign source packs (DeepSeek/Qwen/Kimi-Linear/Mistral/GLM) remains UNOBSERVED; carried forward. relevant_k0_invariants: PROVENANCE_PRIMARY_EVIDENCE — mechanism cards cite origin_source_ids and source_fact_boundary; closed-model architectural hypotheses are marked as hypotheses (A0/A1), never source facts.

PRESERVE_ABSTENTION — assimilation evidence (ablation/transfer) that cannot be produced is UNOBSERVED; no mechanism is promoted to A2/A3 without real evidence; missing evidence is never silently zero.
MUTATION_REQUIRES_RECEIPT — every state transition A1->A2 and A2->A3 produces a content-addressed AssimilationReceipt; MechanismCandidate is content-addressed and from_dict re-verifies the hash.

SEPARATE_GENERATION_AND_PROMOTION — A3 promotion requires a promotion_authority that is SEPARATE from the mechanism's origin generator; a mechanism cannot self-promote. Only A3 may automatically influence organization-policy generation.

NO_NORMAL_KERNEL_SELF_MUTATION / NO_EXECUTABLE_SELF_MODIFICATION — the assimilation gate is ordinary evolution logic, not constitutional self-modification; no executable self-modification is introduced.
FROZEN_EVALUATION_CONTRACT — transfer/ablation receipts pin regime, evidence_hash, verifier_ref; the evaluation contract is frozen per receipt.
constitution_assessment.amendment_boundary: NOT_IMPLEMENTED — Slice 4 does not amend the constitutional kernel (K0/K1 unchanged).

section_10_mechanism_library.slice_4_scope: Full A0-A3 state machine with evidence-gated transitions (Slice 3 delivered A0/A1 only; Slice 4 adds the A1->A2->A3 assimilation path).
section_10_mechanism_library.slice_4_addition: promotion_authority field (None for A0/A1/A2; required for A3 and must differ from the mechanism's origin generator).
section_10_mechanism_library.retrospective_registration_rule: Existing 2.2/2.3 architecture influences must be retrospectively registered rather than reimplemented under new names.

architecture_library_assessment.section_11_assimilation_loop: EXTERNAL SYSTEM -> SOURCE/BEHAVIOR CHARACTERIZATION -> BEHAVIORAL/ARCHITECTURAL FINGERPRINT -> COMPETING MECHANISM HYPOTHESES -> ABSTRACT MECHANISM -> INDEPENDENT METAENGINE IMPLEMENTATION -> CONTROLLED EXPERIMENT -> ABLATION -> TRANSFER TEST -> ORGANIZATION TOURNAMENT -> REJECT/CONTEXTUAL/TRANSFERABLE/ASSIMILATED. A strong external model is evidence that a capability exists, not proof that MetaEngine knows the mechanism that causes it.

CURRENT.summary: Slice-3 mechanism library admits A0/A1 only and blanket-rejects A2/A3. Cannot satisfy the Slice-4 objective (full A0-A3 state machine + assimilation receipts) or success criteria #7 (distinguish A0/A1/A2/A3 and prevent hypothesis-as-fact promotion).

MINIMAL.summary: Keep A0/A1-only and just add more mechanism cards. Lowest cost but does not deliver the assimilation path, the evidence-gated transitions, or the separate-promotion-authority guard. Violates SEPARATE_GENERATION_AND_PROMOTION (no way to express A3 promotion authority).

LIBRARY.summary: Import an external experiment-tracking/MLflow-style library to manage receipts. Imports a foreign runtime dependency into Core for a concern that is a small typed receipt + gate, and violates the principle that Core stays provider-neutral and dependency-light.

SYNTHESIS.summary: Extend metaengine/mechanism_library.py to the full A0-A3 state machine with evidence-gated admission (A2 requires >=1 ablation + >=1 transfer receipt; A3 requires >=2 transfer receipts across distinct regimes + a non-None promotion_authority differing from the origin generator). Add metaengine/assimilation.py with typed content-addressed ExperimentReceipt/AblationReceipt/TransferReceipt and an AssimilationGate that produces a content-addressed AssimilationReceipt for each transition and enforces no-self-promotion. Retrospectively register existing MetaEngine 2.2/2.3 architecture influences (polycentric_reentry, hybrid_mesh, dialectical_graph, epistemic_gain, parallel_ecology, etc.) as A0/A1 mechanism cards under their existing names. Complete the 12 section-10.4 mechanism families. Do NOT create any A2/A3 mechanisms in the materialized library (no real ablation/transfer evidence in this environment — PRESERVE_ABSTENTION); the gate is exercised by tests with synthetic receipts only. Reuses Slice-2/3 patterns; adds no Core runtime dependency on foreign code.
